name: Senecta
tagline: The coordinated standard of care for aging parents.
positioning: Senecta unifies caregivers, physicians, and family into one authoritative record — so every medication, appointment, and decision is documented and shared.

hero.h1: Coordinated care for the parents who raised you.
hero.sub: Senecta consolidates prescriptions, specialist visits, and daily check-ins into a single family record — replacing the group text, the shoebox of paperwork, and the 11pm phone calls.

features.title: The unified care record
features.description: Every diagnosis, dosage, and directive in one authoritative timeline — accessible to the family members and providers you designate, and no one else.

features.title: Medication reconciliation
features.description: Senecta flags interactions and duplicate prescriptions across every physician, then generates a clean, printable list for each appointment.

features.title: Appointment coordination
features.description: Shared calendars, transport logistics, and post-visit summaries — so the sibling who can't attend still knows exactly what the cardiologist said.

features.title: Caregiver handoffs
features.description: Structured shift notes for home aides and rotating family members, so nothing is lost between the day nurse and the weekend visit.

features.title: Document vault
features.description: Insurance cards, advance directives, and power-of-attorney filings stored securely and retrieved in seconds during an emergency.

features.title: Provider directory
features.description: Every doctor, pharmacy, and facility in one contact ledger with roles and reachability — no more hunting through old voicemails.

testimonials.quote: After Dad's third hospitalization, my brother and I finally stopped contradicting each other with the doctors. Senecta became the single source of truth for his entire medication list.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Adler

testimonials.quote: We manage care for both of my in-laws across two states. The shared timeline meant our home aide and I were finally reading from the same page during every handoff.
testimonials.name: Desmond Ferreira

testimonials.quote: I recommend Senecta to every client navigating a parent's dementia diagnosis. The document vault alone saved one family a two-week delay on a Medicaid filing.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For a single parent's care, coordinated by one family.
For siblings sharing care of both parents across distances.
For professional care managers overseeing multiple households.

homepage.footerBlurb: Senecta is the coordinated standard of care for families guiding aging parents — one record, every decision, documented and shared.
